edits.find_text: Apple rejected Liyla and the Shadows of War from the App Store's Games category at launch in May 2016 and reversed within four days after outcry
edits.new_text: Apple rejected Liyla and the Shadows of War from the App Store's Games category on 18 May 2016, reversed by 20 May after outcry, and the app was live in the Games category by 22 May
edits.rationale: The verification pins the dates: rejected 18 May 2016, reversal announced by 20 May, live as a Game by 22 May, and recommends exactly this wording over 'within four days'.
Adds the source for the 20 May reversal date, which the TouchArcade piece (18 May) cannot carry; the URL is taken from the verification file.

edits.find_text: Gazans colloquially say al-yahud for the army and the state; the BBC's 2025 row over translating it shows why it would swallow the game's reception
edits.new_text: Gazans colloquially say al-yahud for the army and the state. After its 2025 review of a Gaza documentary the BBC told staff to translate the word literally, as Jews, and that row shows why it would swallow the game's reception
edits.rationale: After the July 2025 Johnston review the BBC's guidance defaults to the literal translation, so the sentence must not read as if translating it as 'Israeli' were still accepted; the design rule that characters say 'they' is unchanged.

edits.new_text: · [Times of Israel, BBC guidance on yahud, July 2025](https://www.timesofisrael.com/bbc-says-gaza-documentary-in-breach-by-not-disclosing-narrator-was-hamas-officials-son/)
edits.rationale: Adds the source for the BBC's 2025 default to the literal translation, which the Jerusalem Post link alone does not state; the URL is taken from the verification file.

edits.find_text: Maher Zain's vocals-only album sold hundreds of thousands
edits.new_text: Maher Zain's Thank You Allah sold hundreds of thousands and was reissued as a vocals-only edition
edits.rationale: The sales figure belongs to the album as a whole (Wikipedia, over 300,000 copies) and the vocals-only edition is a separate 2012 reissue; the verification notes the two facts come from different sources, so the doc must not credit the sales to the vocals-only edition.

edits.new_text: as Gaza school custom expects from about her age
edits.rationale: The age-12 threshold rests on an unverified grade mapping, so the cast row should carry the same 'from about her age' wording the Characters paragraph already uses.

edits.find_text: the eight-year-old killed when a wedding tent was shelled in December 2025
edits.new_text: the eight-year-old killed when shelling hit the shelter beside a wedding tent in Gaza City in December 2025
